 Follow Miranda Lambert Reflects on Difficult Blake Shelton Divorce 11 Years Later: ‘A Really Not Fun Time’
 Isha Sharma Updated Wed, October 28, 2026 at 2:53 PM UTC 3 min read Add Yahoo as a preferred source to see more of our stories on Google. Xavier Collin/Image Press Agency / MEGA; ZUMAPRESS.com / MEGA More than a decade after her marriage to Blake Shelton ended, Miranda Lambert is looking back on the aftermath of their divorce and the songs she wrote to work through it .
 On the latest episode of songwriter Ross Golan 's podcast, And The Writer Is… , released Tuesday, October 27, Lambert, 42, recalled returning to Nashville after their 2015 split and writing about 75 songs during that period.
 Lambert and Shelton , 50, were together for 10 years and married for four before announcing their divorce in July 2015.
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement "I got divorced and that sucks for anyone, especially in the public eye, especially on tour, especially in the middle of a very public career, two of us, you know what I mean? It just was a really not fun time," Lambert said.
 Byron Purvis/AdMedia/Newscom/The Mega Agency
 The three-time Grammy winner spent much of her marriage living in Shelton's hometown of Tishomingo, Oklahoma, before returning to Nashville after the split.
 "And I, in the meantime, had moved back to Nashville full-time, and so I dove headfirst into songwriting. I had missed it," she added.
 Lambert said returning to Tennessee let her reconnect with longtime friends and fellow songwriters.
 Advertisement Advertisement "When I moved back in 2015, I gathered up all of my friends and relationships from all of the previous years and just used it," she recalled. "Used the misery."
 The "Bluebird" singer also credited the community that helped her navigate through that period. "I used what I was living, and my friends went on that journey with me, friends being songwriters," she said. "And I think I wrote 75 songs."
 Many of those songs shaped her critically acclaimed double album, The Weight of These Wings . Released in November, 2016, it was her sixth studio album and held 24 tracks across two discs, The Nerve and The Heart .
 AdMedia/Newscom/The Mega Agency
 The album hit No. 1 on Billboard's Top Country Albums chart and went Platinum, according to BroadwayWorld . It also won Album of the Year at the 2017 ACM Awards.
 Advertisement Advertisement Unlike her previous album, Platinum , Lambert explained, "it wasn't writing towards a specific record or a sound or a feisty or whatever. It was raw emotion."
 She said the experience helped her grow as a songwriter. "It was kind of magical," she added.
 Lambert found love again with former NYPD officer Brendan McLoughlin , whom she married in 2019. Meanwhile, Shelton wed Gwen Stefani , his fellow coach on The Voice , in 2021.
 Shelton is now stepfather to Stefani's three sons with ex-husband Gavin Rossdale : Kingston , 20, Zuma , 18, and Apollo , 12.
